end.summary:
Practised ordering cell, tissue, organ, organ system, and organism.
Used human and plant examples, including heart, stomach, leaf, and circulatory system.
The organ-versus-organ-system mix-up was corrected after discussing heart, blood vessels, and blood.
Discussed amoeba as a single cell that uses pseudopodia for feeding and movement; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the levels of organisation using ladder ordering and concrete examples from humans, plants, and amoeba. Yash correctly connected cells to tissues and tissues to organs, and later corrected the mix-up by identifying the heart as one part of the circulatory system. At home, ask Yash to arrange the five levels and give one example for each, explaining why an organ system contains several organs.
